chunks: What ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn narrated from Aḥmad ibn al-Ḥasan, from ʿAmr ibn Saʿīd, from Muṣaddiq ibn Ṣadaqah, from ʿAmmār al-Sābāṭī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The deceased is prayed over so long as he has not been covered with earth, even if salat (prayer) has already been performed over him.

key_terms.صُلِّيَ: the prayer had already been performed
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ: over him, referring to the deceased
key_terms.يُوَارَ: is covered or concealed in burial

ai.seo_question: Can salat (prayer) over the deceased be repeated before the burial is completed?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning salat (prayer) over the deceased before burial is completed. It indicates that as long as the deceased has not yet been covered with earth, the funeral prayer may still be performed, even if it had already been offered previously.
